# DASH Supplemental

> > DASH Supplemental provides accident and sickness insurance coverage for individuals, families, and small businesses across Canada, with a focus on Health Spending Accounts (HSA) and flexible supplemental health insurance plans.

DASH Supplemental operates primarily in Alberta and British Columbia, offering insurance products that complement provincial health coverage like AHCIP. The company specializes in no-waiting-period policies with locked-in premiums, serving both individual clients and small businesses through HSA Basic, HSA Plus, and HSA Group plans administered via Olympia Benefits.

## Key Topics

- Accident and sickness insurance
- Health Spending Accounts (HSA)
- Supplemental insurance coverage
- Alberta Health Care Insurance Plan (AHCIP)
- HSA Basic and HSA Plus
- Small business benefits
- Individual and family plans
- Workplace safety and injury prevention
- Canada insurance regulations (CRA)
- No waiting period coverage
- Locked-in premiums
- Olympia Benefits administration
- Alberta and BC coverage
- Coverage specialists
